answer: A bond is refunded only after 29 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ferrous counter is kept in basalt and saffron shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 29 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 118 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
